title: The Quran's Retirement Ceremony: How the Corpus Confirms Ibn Abbas Read a Death Into Surah An-Nasr
excerpt: Seven of the Quran's heaviest words — praise, help, victory, religion, glorification, forgiveness, repentance — all take their final appearance inside the three verses of An-Nasr. After it, the only command left in the Book is 'Say.'
seo_title: Surah An-Nasr: Ibn Abbas Read a Death Into It
seo_description: Seven of the Quran's heaviest roots make their final appearance inside Surah An-Nasr's three verses, and only 'Say' remains after it. A close reading of Ibn Abbas's famous interpretation.
